items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: he gave Pickett a job, John Brunson, and John called me

ctx.x: And then from then it went to, they kept it a while, and then who was that other fellow of that guy for?

Oh I can't think of his name but he gave Pickett a job, John Brunson, and John called me and asked him about taking the job and he would play some nights. And that's when we had went to the happy land.
One thing I wanted to ask you, when George Garner left the band, and I believe you had Smitty playing there. We had Frank Moyer first.
